plans.note: Section 15 'LIMITATION OF GARMAN'S LIABILITY' is the primary target; heading suggests one-sided cap. Check amount, mutuality, exclusion of consequential damages, and whether carve-outs (IP indemnity in sec-13, confidentiality in sec-14) are preserved.

Section 13 'INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY INDEMNITY' should cover vendor IP indemnity; assess defence/settlement control, remedy options (procure/replace/refund) and whether any customer-side indemnity is broader than narrow misconduct. Note any absence of indemnity for Garman's own misconduct.

No non-compete heading; check use restrictions (sec-3) and General Matters (sec-20) for any covenant limiting Sparkling's businesses or competing products. Likely absent in a software licence of this type.
Scan the licence grant, maintenance and fees sections for any sole-source or exclusive-supplier language (e.g., maintenance may only be obtained from Garman); otherwise absent.
Check Fees (sec-11) and Maintenance (sec-10) for most-favoured-customer pricing language; only flag if it obliges Sparkling to give Garman best terms. MFN in our favour is welcome and not flagged.

Section 19 'NON-SOLICITATION OF EMPLOYEES' is directly on point; check mutuality, duration, scope (solicit vs hire) and whether a general-advertising/unsolicited-response carve-out exists. Also check sec-18 survival for its post-term duration.

Section 17 'TERM AND TERMINATION' governs; check whether Sparkling has termination for convenience on notice without penalty and whether Garman can terminate mid-term. Sections 7-8 (option to reject software) are a related early-exit mechanic to cite.
Look for maintenance term auto-renewal and notice window in sec-17 and the maintenance/fee provisions (sec-10, sec-11), including any annual maintenance-fee uplift mechanism.

Governing law, venue and any dispute-resolution/arbitration clause will sit in Section 20 'GENERAL MATTERS'; confirm law is NY/DE/CA/England & Wales and that courts, not foreign arbitration, have jurisdiction.

Assignment clause expected in General Matters; check for affiliate/successor assignment right for Sparkling, consent standards, and any Garman termination right on Sparkling's change of control (also check sec-17).

Ownership statements likely in the grant/restrictions (sec-2, sec-3); check data conversion (sec-4) and confidentiality (sec-14) for treatment of Sparkling's data, and escrow (sec-16) for source-code rights. Flag only if Sparkling's data or paid-for modifications vest in Garman.

Section 2 grant plus Section 3 restrictions and the definitions/schedules (sec-1, e.g., Authorized Locations) determine scope; check affiliate and contractor/outsourcer use, site limits, and whether the licence is perpetual/irrevocable rather than revocable at will.
No audit heading; check restrictions on use (sec-3) and General Matters for inspection/verification rights over Sparkling's usage, including frequency, notice and cost allocation.
Check Fees (sec-11) for late-payment interest or penalty amounts and sec-17 for early-termination charges; service credits in our favour under maintenance (sec-10) are welcome and not flagged.

Section 12 'SPECIFICATIONS AND WARRANTY' is primary; assess warranty period, conformity to specifications, remedy (repair/replace/refund), and any disclaimer of implied warranties (may also appear in sec-15). Acceptance testing (sec-6) and rejection rights (sec-7, sec-8) are supporting remedies.

No insurance heading in the outline; check General Matters and the indemnity section for any certificate/coverage undertaking. If none, treat as missing given Garman personnel perform installation, conversion and support on our data.
Check Fees (sec-11) and Maintenance (sec-10) for minimum licence counts, committed maintenance years or take-or-pay obligations and whether an exit exists; also check schedules referenced in sec-1.

Look in sec-17/sec-18 for post-termination obligations (return/destruction of materials) — these often run against us only. Assess whether Sparkling gets its data back and exit assistance; source-code escrow (sec-16) is a partial substitute to cite.
